about_the_game:
DION – A Survival Game Inspired by West African Empires

Dive into DION, a multiplayer survival game that transports you to the heart of a brutal world inspired by the great West African empires. Here, only your ingenuity and strength will determine your fate.

🌍 A Persistent and Ruthless World
Explore rich and diverse landscapes, from arid savannas to lush jungles. Every resource matters, and every encounter could be an opportunity… or a threat.

⚒️ Build, Craft, Survive
Manage your base, craft your own tools and weapons, and hunt to ensure your survival.

⚔️ Fight or Cooperate
In DION, diplomacy is just as powerful as the sword. Form alliances, betray your enemies, and dominate the wild lands.

🔮 Unleash Your Power: Transform!
Master the ancient art of shapeshifting and take on the form of mythical or wild animals. Whether hunting your enemies, escaping imminent danger, or harnessing unique abilities, transformation is a formidable weapon.

🔥 A Rich Lore Inspired by History
Discover a fascinating universe inspired by 13th-century West African civilizations, where legends and traditions intertwine with survival and conquest.

  • Graphics: GTX 960

short_description: A survival game set in the heart of the great West African empires. The rules? There are none. Manage your base, craft your tools, gather resources, hunt, and impose your will on other players in this persistent, ruthless, and open world!
